title: Index every replicated compiler source row using polynomially many chronological states
body:
## Result
Give exact rank/unrank between fresh compiler source occurrences and consecutive integer rows, including replicas. Use aggregated (depth, paid product, last rank) state counts rather than enumerating the full class tree.

## Novelty and predecessors
Extends the Pascal codec to actual row numbers. Repairs a deterministic-cost defect in hash-based metadata via sorted tables and separately charged serialized fixed-tape scans.

## Verification
Independent functional and adversarial collision-family reviews; run python3 -I -W error -B research/lockstep-source-row-index/verify.py.

## Limits and kappa
Addresses, not payload movement, selected native manifest or complete compiler closure. No new kappa; 0.00363005817 remains conditional.

## Credit
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit predecessor authors and PRs as detailed in the package.

Full proof, reproducibility, negative controls and provenance: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/c5bcb6dc792f5fe4d8abe89a2a2854f148b09f2c/research/lockstep-source-row-index
